note: Bolivar County (FIPS 28011) has no queryable zoning district layer. The county GIS service (bolivarms org, Bolivar_Service) holds parcels and lines only, with no zoning field. Cleveland, the county seat and largest city, publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (R-1 to X-1 districts, 2017 adoption, amended 2024). The county planning land use map is also a static PDF. Rosedale, Shelby and Mound Bayou showed no zoning service in search.
